Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) address_name, procedure_address, procedure_pseudo_code: Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) address_name, procedure_address, procedure_pseudo_code: Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) address_name, procedure_address, procedure_pseudo_code: The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) address_name, procedure_address, procedure_pseudo_code: The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.

Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) address_name, procedure_address, procedure_pseudo_code: macOS sessions require a matching executable Ghidra native decompiler; REA checks for it but does not build native components or change Gatekeeper quarantine state.
Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) procedure_address: External functions and local thunks are distinct; procedure metadata identifies both and preserves a thunk target when Ghidra resolves one.
Ghidra (ghidra 12.1.4) procedure_pseudo_code: External functions and functions without an analyzable body return null; other decompiler failures remain explicit.
